catalog.title: Send your company's product catalog
catalog.intro: Attach your catalog (PDF, spreadsheet, images…) and, if you like, fill in the template with items and prices — your products get into our records faster that way.

catalog.sheetHint: Download the spreadsheet, fill in one row per product (description and unit are required) and upload it back here. We also read your own spreadsheet if the columns have similar names.

template.title: Product catalog — template
template.subtitle: To be sent to {{empresa}}
template.meta: One row per product. Description and unit are required; the grey row is just an example.
template.help1: 1. Fill in the “Itens” tab starting on the row below the black header — one row per product.
template.help2: 2. Description and Unit are required. Unit: UN, KG, M, M2, M3, L, CX, PC, SC, TON (or the one you use).
template.help3: 3. Unit price in BRL, without itemized taxes (e.g. 38.90). Leave blank if you prefer not to say.
template.help4: 4. Brand and reference/part number help identify the product in our records.
template.help5: 5. You may delete the example row. Then upload the file through the same link where you downloaded this spreadsheet.
